buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Provisions for workmen compensation, insurance, public liability, property damage, insurance etc. to be ensured by the contractor. Also, safety measures prescribed for working in Extra High Voltage & use of personnel protective equipment must be adhered to. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 4. Service & Support

Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Conditions for Jaggery (Gud) to be mandatorily fulfill by all the participants on GeM Portal through e-bid: 1. Firms/Bidders are to mandatorily submit the two samples in 100 gm packing each before the opening of bid end date, failing which the bidder is liable for the cancellation of its participation. The samples once submitted by the bidders will be considered as final submission, and no further re-submission of samples will be allowed after the evaluation of the samples. 2. The samples submitted by the bidder (L1) shall be placed as control sample. The subsequent supply of the store shall be confirming to the approved sample. It is highlighted that variance of make other than the approved sample shall not be accepted. The sample once approved, only are to be supplied by the firm ag ainst the subsequent orders. 3. The firms/bidders must have valid FSSAI License No. relevant in respect of th e quoted items/product under the FSSAI Act, 2006. The Resellers/Authori zed Di stributors/OEM participating in the bid must submit the same. The non-submissi on of the aforementioned relevant FSSAI license will lead to the disqualification of its participation. 4. ATC acceptance, undertaking (As per Proforma A & B respectively) required f rom each participant on firms’ letter head duly signed & stamped. 5. If the firms claim for MSME/Udyam (Manufacturing) exemption in experience & EMD, firm should be register in the specific products. Note: This bid is for the procurement of 37080 Kilogram of Jaggery (Gu d). The bidder must submit the rates of superior quality of Jaggery (Gu d) only. The seller has to supply the goods in Central Jail No.1 (Main Store), Tihar and be fore supply they have to procure ‘Entry pass’ from Provision Branch-II, Room No -27, Prison Headquarter, Gate No.01, Central Jail Tihar, New Delhi-110064 betwe en 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM. Additionally, the Advanced samples must also be subm itted to the Provision Branch-II at PHQ. Further, goods entry at Main Store will be take up 2-4 hours due to scheduled ‘Security Check-up’ in jail. Performa-A
